text:
Nina: Heads-up, I put together a rollout approach for the new slice-governor feature (region-aware routing + per-tenant priority). Goal: minimize churn during global shipping windows and let Sales opt customers into region-only variants. Need ops + eng-platform sign-off on canary durations, experiment overlap rules, and fallback policy.

Owen: Nice. Core constraints: no more than 2 simultaneous model-facing experiments per tenant, and experiments should not overlap with billing changes. Suggest 4-stage regional ramp: smoke (internal only), region alpha (5%), region beta (25%), global (100%). Make smoke 48h, alpha 48h, beta 24h, global final.

Sasha: Telemetry we need: routed_requests_by_region, p99_latency, queue_depth, per-tenant_error_rate, token_cost_change. For quality A/B we'll run an opt-in cohort of 2% where prompts are mirrored and scored by the eval harness. If match_rate drops >0.8% OR hallucination_score increases >1.0pt -> auto-degrade.

Diego: For fallback policy, propose priority ladder: 1) per-tenant override to previous model, 2) regional rollback to nearest stable model, 3) global mitigate -> reduce serving pct by half every 15m until at 0. Include a tagged incident if we hit p99 delta > 30% for > 30m.

Nina: Good. Also planning a decay policy for the feature flag to avoid flag creep. After full global ship, flag enters "monitoring" state for 30 days, then auto-promote to permanent release and remove temporary gates. Need product/legal to approve retention windows for telemetry. @Liza any concerns?

Liza: Fine with telemetry retention. Customer opt-in API needs explicit consent flow for EU tenants. Also Sales asked for a per-tenant preview toggle and an audit log entry for each toggle flip. We'll require 48h lead time for enterprise opt-ins.

Owen: Automation: I'll add an orchestration job that runs the phased increases and checks gating queries every 15m. If any gate trips it pauses and notifies oncall + #shiproom. Gate example rule: (p99_latency_increase>25% && error_rate>0.4%) OR sustained_queue_len>100.

Sasha: Dashboards & example query to add:
```sql
-- p99 latency delta between slice-governor and baseline (last 15m)
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,99) FILTER (WHERE tag='slice-governor') - percentile(latency_ms,99) FILTER (WHERE tag='baseline') FROM requests SINCE 15m
```
Add token_cost_ratio over last 1h too.

Diego: Minimal runbook (short):
1) Pause rollout job (`rbctl rollout pause --flag slice-governor --phase alpha`)
2) Apply per-tenant override (`rbctl flag set --flag slice-governor --tenant 54321 --pct 0`)
3) Verify traffic drained from region and model pools in console
4) Notify customers + start incident bridge if enterprise affected
5) After mitigation, schedule a root-cause check and decide resume vs revert

Nina: Who owns phase gates & manual rollback? Ops oncall owns smoke/alpha, eng-platform owns beta/global. Need agreement.

Owen: Agreed. Also request to freeze unrelated model flags for the duration of alpha & beta windows. We'll annotate the rollout with a unique correlation id so telemetry can filter noise.

Sasha: A/B experiment overlap rules: if a tenant is in an unrelated active experiment with >5% treatment, exclude from slice-governor alpha cohort. We'll surface a "conflict" flag in the rollout UI.

Liza: Compliance: log retention for per-tenant previews set to 90 days, audit entries for toggle flips persisted in KMS-protected store. CV note: EU opt-ins need DPA sign-off.

eng-platform-bot: orchestration scheduled -> slice-governor release/canary -> smoke window 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z (ETA)

Nina: Final checklist before smoke:
- staging mirror soak 12h with region tags
- smoke eval run on 5k prompts
- dashboard panels live + alert policies created (pager + slack)
- per-tenant toggle API docs published
- legal & sales opt-in process documented

Diego: I'll prepare the ab test harness and the mirror wiring. Also will add the circuit breaker that halves pct every 15m on sustained error condition.

Owen: One more: define success window for each phase (must pass two consecutive 15m gating checks spanning 2h) before progressing. If any gating check fails, require manual approve to resume.

Nina: Perfect. I'll post PRD updates and link the rollout playbook. Shiproom invite after CI passes. Thanks all. :rocket:
